content.p: tape deck is a script i made to put music on my pages easy. here it is in case it helps you
lets you define a tracklist and then play those tracks in order. adds a play button, skip button, and a div that displays the name of the current track.

make a copy of the script on your site. open your copy and change its path field to match the folder you're storing your music files in. (by default, it's set to my filegarden because that's where i store mine.)
add a deck to your page like this
content.code-block: <script defer src="tape-deck.js"></script> <tape-deck shuffle list=" track 1 track 2 track 3 "><tape-deck>

ul.li: list, a line-separated list of track names
shuffle. shuffles the tracklist if present
single. removes the skip button if present

content.p: make sure that track names match the names of mp3 files in your music folder (the one you defined in path). when its a track's turn to be played, the script'll find an mp3 in the music folder with the same name and play it.
